prd_rules.summary: KAIROS consolidation is PHP-first with optional LLM assist, never model-only authority.
Conflicting topic memories require explicit kairos_contradicts edge representation.
Truth ordering prefers recency unless stronger validated evidence edges justify override.
Memory consolidation actions must preserve lineage and avoid hard-delete semantics.
Temporal discipline forbids backward-reading assumptions in consolidation state transitions.

definitions.meaning: Atomic note row in lupo_actor_memory used as consolidation input.
Consolidated memory row produced from normalized observations.
Edge relation linking consolidated memory to its source observations.
Edge relation recording contradictory consolidated claims under shared topic key.
Normalization key grouping memory candidates for consolidation and contradiction checks.
